vendors.name: Restimo
vendors.reason: Polish ordering platform with € prices ('ORDERING' €39/month per store; 'All prices are net (excluding VAT).', pricing for clients outside Poland) and a contact-form country dropdown that includes Estonia; but neither its pricing page nor its ordering page mentions pickup, takeaway or ordering ahead ('5 Countries', no country named in a sentence). Fails the order-ahead rule.

vendors.name: Telli Toit
vendors.reason: Estonian consumer food-ordering app (pre-order and pick up yourself; courier delivery stopped 20.06.2022 per its App Store listing) - a shared consumer app across venues, no business price or own site found. Not opened.

notes: EE counts FoxiFood and Jitmeal. No third found. Earlier evidence not counted: Poster (Estonia page, USD only - its Estonia ad page in today's search again shows '$24 per month'), Storekit (GBP only), SumUp (generic web shop - the single-fallback type, eligible EUR 0 in compare-research-2), EestiPOS, Tellikohe, Kassahaldus (rejected/unreadable). One Estonian search returned Wolt (marketplace), Subger, Restimo (Polish; no Estonia presence shown), TalTech theses and Capterra. EE stays at 2 (3 only if the coordinator lets SumUp's web shop count as a third). Second pass: Restimo (Polish, € prices, shows up in many countries' searches) read - no pickup / order-ahead wording, so not eligible anywhere on its own pages; Erply/Tickett/Smartpos did not surface. EE stays at 2. Third pass (Estonian 'eeltellimus ... toiduauto'): only Uber Eats for Business, Wolt, Telli Toit (consumer app), Sigosoft and Kavapp (custom dev / RU). After about 6 new sites, nothing. Second pass (coordinator, food-truck angles): festival organisers (Tallinn Food Truck Festival, Tallinn Street Food Festival, DK Entertainment) name no ordering tool; Estonian food-truck / Google Play searches find only Wolt (LIT truck's scheduled orders on the marketplace), Telli Toit (consumer app), Ticket Fairy blog (US) and ERR news. No new vendor site worth opening. EE stays at 2.
